column1: # The default table has `factory` filling the flash to the last byte
# place for settings has to be made rather than found. `factory` is cut to
# 3 MB — the image is under 300 KB — and `config` takes 32 KB after it.
# Nothing in the firmware knows these numbers. The table is read from flash at
# run time and the partition is found by label; an offset in the source would
# be a constant that silently rots the first time this file changes.
